scope: Confirmed absence of nine older shared contracts; this is not a claim that the dedicated Goodies RPCs are missing. Pure Goodies guarded paths are covered by regression tests. Full mixed-feature workspace operation is not certified.

contracts.name: feature_requirements_status
contracts.context: Shared registration branch used when the business is not Goodies-only; the Goodies-only branch uses the current business-application APIs.

contracts.name: submit_requirement
contracts.context: Legacy shared registration upload handler; the Goodies-only application uses submit_business_application_document.

contracts.name: submit_verification
contracts.context: Legacy shared registration submission; the Goodies-only application uses the current application workflow.

contracts.name: register_push_token
contracts.context: Non-Goodies workspace branch. Goodies explicitly skips it and now uses the deployed, session-bound Goodies device APIs.

contracts.name: go_live
contracts.context: Shared checklist branch when its first feature is not Goodies; the Goodies branch opens the existing store setup/publication page.

contracts.name: dashboard_range
contracts.context: Shared non-Goodies or mixed-feature financial dashboard. Goodies-only workspaces use goodies_vendor_dashboard_range.

contracts.name: action_required
contracts.context: Shared non-Goodies or mixed-feature actions feed. Goodies-only workspaces use scoped real order/product/conversation queries.

contracts.name: activity_feed
contracts.context: Shared non-Goodies or mixed-feature activity feed. Goodies-only workspaces use real account/business notifications.

contracts.name: search_business
contracts.context: Shared non-Goodies or mixed-feature search. Goodies-only workspaces use scoped real products/orders.
